before.mapping: Markov coding and Gibbs cylinder estimates yield the weighted two-endpoint pressure exponent; uniqueness and mixing identify equilibrium measures, strict convexity from nonconstant periodic unstable multipliers gives P(phi)>2h_top, analyticity and Hessian identify the perturbative variance. Endpoint comparison and kick coefficient are derived in the project rather than quoted as standalone external theorems. Additional FM-018 use: product-Hölder-norm exponential correlation bound from Proposition 2.4, pulled back through the Hölder Markov coding; FM-001 supplies mixing Anosov dynamics and FM-006 supplies the normalized-area Gibbs identification. Sobolev embedding yields O11. The quantum Egorov and singular-gap steps are derived in the project.
